decisionScope: Wujie V1 core_translation: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B server ASR, Hy-MT2 translation, VoxCPM2 TTS, and explicit on-device fallback

default.reason: Frozen unified multilingual evidence and real iPhone/Beelink sessions select Qwen3-ASR-1.7B with MarbleNet as the Wujie online main route; stable-readable partial, English, Chinese, meeting, noise, phone and code-switch evidence are reported separately.

gray.reason: The verified iPhone CoreML path remains the explicit on-device route when the user selects local processing; it does not override the online Qwen selection.

fallback.reason: SenseVoice/RMS is retained only as an explicit degraded server fallback. Runtime health and release identity must never report it as the selected Qwen/MarbleNet route.

default.reason: Beelink product-fit evaluation passed 12/12 cases with P50 152 ms and P95 303 ms, so use Hy-MT2 as the domestic server-side translation main model. The 3424 MB max torch VRAM result is retained only as capacity-planning evidence, not a release gate.

gray.reason: Keep Qwen as a quality fallback for difficult context, summaries and AI Agent text tasks, but not as the main release blocker.

fallback.reason: LMT-60-0.6B stays as a low-cost fallback only after segmentation and de-duplication, because mixed-language input is weaker than Hy-MT2.

default.reason: VoxCPM2 is the selected online speech route. The current real HTTP gate returns 24 kHz PCM16 and passed first-audio, identity and cancellation prerequisites; captions remain available when TTS degrades.

gray.reason: System TTS remains the explicit on-device route and fallback when online speech is disabled or unavailable.

fallback.reason: Android system TTS remains the practical fallback for cross-platform MVP playback.

crossPlatformCall.tts: voxcpm2/VoxCPM2 main call TTS contract with system TTS captions fallback; qwen3_tts_candidate remains baseline
crossPlatformCall.releasePolicy: core_translation private beta; PSTN and Agent remain deferred

onlineRealtime.speaker: sortformer active CPU provisional attribution
onlineRealtime.releasePolicy: selected Wujie V1 core route; requires traceable runtime and end-to-end reliability gates

evidence.cosyVoice2RuntimeIssue: Current venv cannot use the official torchaudio/torchcodec/FFmpeg path; prompt/reference/text_frontend/stream variants all failed ASR-proxy intelligibility.

notes: Hy-MT2-1.8B, Qwen3-ASR, FireRedASR2-AED, LMT-60-0.6B, Qwen3-TTS and CosyVoice2 model cards list Apache-2.0 licenses as of this review.
Wujie V1 private beta selects the observable server cascade while preserving an explicit on-device mode; it does not claim that isolated model evidence is production acceptance.
Hy-MT2-1.8B remains the main self-hosted translation model; commercial capacity and public HTTPS remain separate release gates.
VoxCPM2 is selected for online TTS with captions-only degradation; PSTN playback and public release remain deferred by the core_translation profile.
Qwen3-ASR-1.7B requires a controlled GPU headroom contract and complete 100-tail plus 30-minute reliability evidence before release acceptance.

deferredCandidates.reason: Retained only for an isolated second-pass contract. It has no native partial/token stream and does not replace the selected Qwen realtime route.

Official runtime generated 24 kHz streaming audio with good first-audio latency, but baseline ASR-proxy intelligibility passed 0/6 and prompt/reference/runtime diagnostic also passed 0/6. Build an isolated official runtime environment before product use.
